questions.stem: On a flight over the Arabian Sea one year, Kabir watched the clouds gather below the aircraft and wondered why the rain always ends up over the land and not over the sea. Consider the following statements. 1. Winds move from high-pressure areas to low-pressure areas, so moist winds blow from the ocean towards the land and bring rainfall. 2. During summer the landmass of India heats up faster than the surrounding oceans, which creates a low-pressure area over the Indian subcontinent. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.stem: Nisha's grandmother in India gets her woollen clothes out in the months when the north-east monsoon arrives, and Nisha has heard someone say that these winter winds blow in from the ocean just as the summer winds do. Consider the following statements. 1. The winter monsoon, also known as the north-east monsoon, occurs in India from October to February, and during this season the Indian landmass cools faster than the surrounding oceans, creating a high-pressure area over the land and low pressure over the seas. 2. The winter monsoon blows moist winds from the ocean towards the land, because during these months the landmass of India heats up faster than the surrounding oceans. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: The assertion is true but the reason is false.
